cases.name: Exactly four game WebContentsViews plus isolated local controls in one BaseWindow
Four distinct original-UI tab contracts are selected and retained independently
Game renderers have no Node, preload or local Workspace bridge
All renderers accept trusted input, keep independent values and scroll independently
Column and grid bounds resize without overlap; split changes and zoom preserve all webContents
Local header IPC works and invalid indices/actions cannot create extra instances
The visible separator pointer handler resizes the native game views through the restricted control bridge
A native React remount resetting the active tab is corrected through the verified UI in compact mode
A changed tab becoming a submit button is rejected without any automatic click
Unknown tab IDs restore the original view and never trigger another tab click
A delayed DOM observation from an outgoing document cannot overwrite the reloaded tab state
Manual page refresh uses original documents and restores all four tab contracts
Compact presentation removes and restores CSS without replacing original buttons
External navigation, redirects and popups are denied
Existing original mining-read HTTP failures and successful retries update only the affected status
HTTP 429 is shown as a server limit without guessed tab changes or an automatic reload
Interrupted navigation is reported and manual refresh recovers the same renderer
Closing BaseWindow destroys four game contents and local controls
Own synthetic HttpOnly cookie survives a real Electron restart
